title: The Privacy Budget
description: A data market can't pay you for your data's value AND protect it with one privacy budget ε. Drag ε: the worst-case leakage bound hits ≈100% by ε=8 — exactly where from-scratch models finally become usable. Real attacks sit far below the bound, and that gap is your only cover.
